vetSays.line: ★ IDENTIFIED: Ground Elder. Creeping patches of divided leaves in shady spots. Uses unknown — harvest, taste, and learn.
📚 Village knowledge: Sofia taught everyone about Ground Elder. The Codex grows without you lifting a finger.
The fire burns low. 8 new lines in the journal tonight — loudest: Ground Elder — named and noted.
🌿 Ground Elder — the foragers have handled it 8 days running. They know it now — which parts are worth hauling, which bruise, how it wants to be carried. The village's knowledge deepens.
💡 Ground Elder: the village knows more than you do. Harvest it a few more times (0/3) and it'll click.
🛡️ Lina, Sofia, Raj and Hassan met them at the door — 4 put down. Lina, Sofia, Raj, Hassan are hurt.
⚠ This one is different — scarred, braced, waiting for your opening. A Scarred veteran.
It saw the opening coming — braced, scar tissue white. Your first strike glances off. (SCARRED: -3 first strike)
The Scarred Glasswing Darter falls.
📺 +20 style — dropped the Scarred Glasswing Darter!

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
🛡️ Dylan, Lisa, Raj and David met them at the door — 4 put down. Dylan, Lisa, Raj, David are hurt.
🌿 Ground Elder, weeks in the baskets. Handling it day after day, the village has learned what it's FOR — not just what it is. The village knows its uses now.
💡 Ground Elder: the village knows more than you do. Harvest it a few more times (0/2) and it'll click.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Lisa just put down The Callback... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Dylan, Lisa and Sofia met them at the door — 1 put down, 1 driven off, 1 barely walked away. Dylan, Sofia are hurt.

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. One day humanity will need a case to make. The case is made of deeds, not words — and yours, though unfinished, are undeniable. (Feasted buffs burn ho
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? David just put down Spool... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 "But finales — FINALES need a LEGEND, sweetheart. More STANDING — blood, bonds, or bread — and look the Mirror Draft in the eye. The producers are WAITING."
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Xiufang just put down The Herald... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Nikolai and Xiufang met them at the door — 1 put down, 1 barely walked away. Nikolai is hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Diana just put down Big Ugly... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Valentina just put down The Congregation... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."

regDeaths.name: a drumbeat with no drummer, getting closer
a dog-shaped silence at the treeline
